claims.text: Nitroimidazole that works against anaerobic bacteria (takeaway, what-is)
claims.quote: Metronidazole, a nitroimidazole, exerts antibacterial effects in an anaerobic environment against most obligate anaerobes.

claims.text: Protozoal and other uses: trichomoniasis, amebiasis, intra-abdominal and gynecologic (pelvic) anaerobic infections (takeaway, uses table, FAQ)
claims.quote: FLAGYL is indicated in the treatment of acute intestinal amebiasis (amebic dysentery) and amebic liver abscess. ... INTRA-ABDOMINAL INFECTIONS, including peritonitis, intra-abdominal abscess, and liver abscess ... GYNECOLOGIC INFECTIONS, including endometritis, endomyometritis, tubo-ovarian abscess

claims.text: Available as tablets taken by mouth
claims.quote: FLAGYL is indicated for the treatment of T. vaginalis infection in females and males

claims.text: No clinically relevant activity against bacteria that use or tolerate oxygen; spares aerobic bacteria
claims.quote: Metronidazole does not possess any clinically relevant activity against facultative anaerobes or obligate aerobes.

claims.text: Reduced drug and free radicals interact with DNA, inhibiting synthesis; precise mechanism unclear
claims.quote: The reduced form of metronidazole and free radicals can interact with DNA leading to inhibition of DNA synthesis ... The precise mechanism of action of metronidazole is unclear.

claims.text: Other anaerobic infections: dose varies by infection
claims.quote: The usual adult oral dosage is 7.5 mg/kg every six hours (approx. 500 mg for a 70-kg adult). ... 750 mg orally three times daily for 5 to 10 days.

claims.text: Finish the full course; skipping doses or stopping early can reduce effectiveness and promote resistance
claims.quote: Skipping doses or not completing the full course of therapy may (1) decrease the effectiveness of the immediate treatment ... increase the likelihood that bacteria will develop resistance and will not be treatable by FLAGYL in the future.

claims.text: Label: avoid alcohol and propylene glycol during and for at least three days after, because cramps, nausea, vomiting, headaches, flushing may occur
claims.quote: Discontinue consumption of alcoholic beverages or products containing propylene glycol while taking FLAGYL and for at least three days afterward because abdominal cramps, nausea, vomiting, headaches, and flushing may occur

claims.text: Do not give metronidazole within two weeks of disulfiram; psychotic reactions reported
claims.quote: Use of oral metronidazole is associated with psychotic reactions in alcoholic patients who were using disulfiram concurrently. ... Do not administer metronidazole to patients who have taken disulfiram within the last two weeks

claims.text: Most common side effects are gastrointestinal, particularly nausea; metallic taste not unusual
claims.quote: The most common adverse reactions reported have been referable to the gastrointestinal tract, particularly nausea, sometimes accompanied by headache ... A sharp, unpleasant metallic taste is not unusual.

claims.text: Darkened urine is rare (about 1 in 100,000), almost certainly a metabolite, no clinical significance (side effects, FAQ, SVG)
claims.quote: Instances of darkened urine have been reported by approximately one patient in 100,000. ... it is almost certainly a metabolite of metronidazole and seems to have no clinical significance.

claims.text: Peripheral neuropathy, persistent in some on prolonged treatment; seizures
claims.quote: Since persistent peripheral neuropathy has been reported in some patients receiving prolonged administration ... Convulsive seizures have been reported in patients treated with metronidazole.

claims.text: Warfarin: stronger anticoagulant effect; INR needs careful monitoring
claims.quote: Metronidazole has been reported to potentiate the anticoagulant effect of warfarin and other oral coumarin anticoagulants ... prothrombin time and INR should be carefully monitored.

claims.text: Lithium: can raise levels; check several days after starting
claims.quote: short-term metronidazole therapy has been associated with elevation of serum lithium ... Serum lithium and serum creatinine levels should be obtained several days after beginning metronidazole

claims.text: Red flags: stop the drug and contact a clinician right away for nerve symptoms or severe skin reactions
claims.quote: should be told to stop the drug and report immediately to their physicians if any neurologic symptoms occur ... If symptoms or signs of SCARs develop, discontinue FLAGYL tablets immediately and institute appropriate therapy.

claims.text: Contact a clinician if severe nausea prevents completing the course
claims.quote: particularly nausea, sometimes accompanied by headache, anorexia, and occasionally vomiting ... not completing the full course of therapy may (1) decrease the effectiveness of the immediate treatment
